name: tribunal-trt13-certid-o-eletr-nica-de-a-es-trabalhistas-ceat-mcp-server
description: Enables users to query Brazilian labor court certificates (CEAT) from TRT13 through an official source. It is a read-only MCP server with pay-per-query pricing that works with any MCP-compatible client like Claude, Cursor, and VS Code.
